proof:
The FY2014 general fund appropriations, pages 24-28. Read from the TEXT LAYER -- these pages carry their own words, so no image was involved. A FORWARD PRINTED ON ITS OWN LINE is counted only when the department below it has NOT folded it into its own appropriated, which the page says by whether that department’s appropriated equals its available. Three such lines appear -- 8,118 above Legal Expenses and 6,150 above Total Insurance are already inside their department totals; 4,000 above Mtc of Town Radios is not, and its available exceeds its appropriated by exactly that. Without the rule the appropriated column is 14,268 out and the other four still tie.

The FY2014 general fund appropriations, pages 24-28. Read from the TEXT LAYER -- these pages carry their own words, so no image was involved. A FORWARD PRINTED ON ITS OWN LINE is counted only when the department below it has NOT folded it into its own appropriated, which the page says by whether that department’s appropriated equals its available. Three such lines appear -- 8,118 above Legal Expenses and 6,150 above Total Insurance are already inside their department totals; 4,000 above Mtc of Town Radios is not, and its available exceeds its appropriated by exactly that. Without the rule the appropriated column is 14,268 out and the other four still tie.

The FY2014 general fund appropriations, pages 24-28. Read from the TEXT LAYER -- these pages carry their own words, so no image was involved. A FORWARD PRINTED ON ITS OWN LINE is counted only when the department below it has NOT folded it into its own appropriated, which the page says by whether that department’s appropriated equals its available. Three such lines appear -- 8,118 above Legal Expenses and 6,150 above Total Insurance are already inside their department totals; 4,000 above Mtc of Town Radios is not, and its available exceeds its appropriated by exactly that. Without the rule the appropriated column is 14,268 out and the other four still tie.
